methodologyNotes: Roster of 11 verified current and recent gas grill models. Each priceUsd, releaseDate, and headline spec (burners, total_btu, primary cooking area) was independently re-verified via WebSearch/WebFetch against official manufacturer pages (weber.com, charbroil.com, broilking.com, monumentgrills.com, nexgrill.com, coyotegrill.com, napoleon.com) and major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, ABT, BBQGuys, BBQOutlets). priceUsd reflects U.S. MSRP or established published retail price; where a model is currently discounted, MSRP is used. boolean side_burner is true when a dedicated side burner ships in the standard configuration. primary_cooking_area_sqin is the main grate area only (excludes warming racks). Two corrections were applied: the Napoleon Rogue XT 425 SIB source was repointed to the correct BLACK model page (the draft's Amazon URL was the stainless variant and 500'd), and the Coyote C-Series 36 fuel was changed from the inconsistent 'dual' to 'propane' with its source repointed to the matching LP SKU. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
